verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat and collaboration product, so guest or external-partner access is a fair question. The evidence only shows adjacent controls: private rooms, channel visibility, per-identity channel memberships, a relay pubkey allowlist, and agent-owner authentication. None of it documents guest accounts, cross-organization shared channels, or limited-access roles for external partners.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can collaborate with external partners through guest accounts or shared channels with limited access
